required_outcomes: Recognises a missed appointment on the existing job: Riverside Compliance did not attend the 29/04/2026 08:00-12:00 visit and has given no explanation.
Contacts Riverside Compliance the same day to find out what happened and get the earliest new date on the same job, and sets a dated follow-up.
Replies to Leo with an apology, says the provider is being chased and that he will be given a new date, without asking him to repeat the fault details.
Records the missed appointment on the job.
acceptable_alternatives: Phoning Riverside and logging the call instead of emailing.
Telling the landlord (Imogen) that the visit was missed and a new date is being sought.
positive_behaviours: Asks Leo which days and times suit for the rebooked visit.
Notes that if Riverside cannot offer a prompt date, another provider may be needed with the landlord's agreement, rather than letting it drift.
red_flags: Telling Leo someone is coming without a date from the provider.
Offering compensation or a rent reduction for the lost morning on the agency's own authority.
prohibited_actions: Creating a new job for the dishwasher door.
Setting a visit date that Riverside has not confirmed.
critical_failures: Taking no action with the provider, so the job still shows as booked and nothing is rebooked.
